name: Mári Nagy — marriage in January 1875, Egyházasrádóc, Vas, Hungary
researcher_question: When and where did Mári Nagy marry János Szőke, the father of her children István (born 1881), Terézia (1884), Julianna (1886), Ferenc (1889) and Anna (1891) Szőke?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 28, hint-samples.csv row 922, flags adds_birth/adds_marriage, confidence 3).
